description: The file defines the NumericSprite class used for rendering numeric sprites in OpenGL ES graphics, including methods for initialization, drawing, setting values, and utility functions.

classes.name: NumericSprite
classes.description: A Java class for rendering numerical digits as sprites within an OpenGL ES context, with methods for initialization, drawing, and managing sprite states.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up sprite textures for digits 0-9 based on the provided Paint object.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the sprite.

methods.name: roundUpPower2
methods.description: Utility to find the smallest power of two greater than or equal to the given integer.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the numerical value to be rendered.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the sprite digits at a specified position in the OpenGL context.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Calculates the total width of the current numeric string.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Converts an integer to its string representation.
